weather_report:
As the afternoon unfolds in Boston, an enveloping blanket of clouds hangs heavy in the sky, hinting at impending showers and the distant rumble of thunderstorms. The air, thickened by patchy fog, lends an almost mystical quality to the surroundings, while the warm breeze carries the promise of a cooling rain, bringing with it the sweet scent of earth and renewal. In this moment where warmth approaches 75 degrees, it seems best to dress comfortably in breathable layers, perhaps a light jacket to shield against both cool drafts and drizzles that are likely to sweep through later. 

As evening settles in and the sky deepens into a slate gray, temperatures will ease into a comfortable 63 degrees, making this a perfect time to embrace the cozy comforts of home or venture out under the canopy of clouds. Whether you find solace in the warmth of a favorite café, engaging in thoughtful conversation, or curl up with a good book while watching the parade of raindrops dance on your windowpane, the essence of the day remains a refreshing slant on summer's typical warmth. Don't shy away from the outdoors entirely; a gentle stroll through the city can reveal the charms that thrive on such gray afternoons, where every shadow tells a story, and the air is alive with the potential of what awaits beyond the clouds.
